definition: Oracle critical-path components plus paired normal-minus-owner-shadow delta. Only the paired delta is strict cross-request Bank exposed time.
components_order: DRAM service and non-cross-request memory wait

weighted_48_layer_estimate.method: nearest-representative-layer weights; extrapolation, not measured full-model endpoint

claim_boundary: Seven one-step layer-isolated full-transaction traces with simultaneous c8 release.
Exact conservation holds per measured layer and for the weighted extrapolation.
The weighted 48-layer result is not an end-to-end full-model simulation.
Zero exposed Bank cycles means Bank waiting is off the measured critical path; it does not mean zero cumulative Bank contention.
